## Changes since v0.1.1

- Added **Graphics pacing**, an independent optional patch that removes Caustic's busy-wait frame limiter and lets display presentation pace rendering without a 60 FPS cap. Graphics-thread CPU usage dropped from about 99% of one core in the original-limiter experiment to single digits with the patch; a subsequent live sample measured 2.8%.
- Updated the bundled AAudio bridge to remove whole-library runtime hashing, allowing it to compose with the graphics patch. The patcher still verifies the original APK and exact native patch inputs and outputs; native initialization guards remain.
- Clarified patch descriptions and added support for all seven MIDI, AAudio and graphics combinations. Graphics-only patching preserves the original DEX unchanged.
- Validated 18,560 integration checks, 9,474 disassembled class comparisons, existing MIDI/audio regression tests, and signing/alignment for all seven combinations. The user also reported no observed issues on the Galaxy Z Fold7 inner display set to 120 Hz; this was not a frame-rate measurement.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/finalpatch/Caustic3Patcher/compare/v0.1.1...v0.1.2)

Download **Caustic3Patcher-v0.1.2.apk** below. **SHA256SUMS** contains its checksum. Requires Android 11+ and ARM64. No original or patched Caustic APK is distributed.

Keep your exported Caustic signing-key backup and password for future updates. If replacing a development patcher signed with a different certificate, export its Caustic signing key before uninstalling the patcher, then import the backup into this release. Caustic itself need not be uninstalled for that migration.
